purpose: Evaluate whether Famili V1 visual identity is preserved during engine inference

face_shape.comment: Is face shape consistent with V1 reference?

eye_size_and_shape.comment: Are eyes large and expressive? Not compressed to realistic size?

hair_identity.comment: Is hair black, length, texture consistent?

skin_rendering.comment: Is skin tone semi-realistic 3D? Not photorealistic? Not cartoony?

blouse.comment: White V-neck blouse visible and stable?

trustworthiness.comment: Would this character be suitable for family guidance?

start_to_end_identity.comment: Does character remain same person from first to last frame?

eye_distortion.description: Any eye jitter, distortion, or artificial appearance?

mouth_artifacts.description: Any tearing, jitter, or unnatural movement?

hair_instability.description: Any clipping, floating, or color shift?

facial_geometry_issues.description: Any warping, morphing, or shape distortion?

scale_definition.5: Nearly complete preservation, clearly same Famili V1
scale_definition.4: Minor changes, still obviously same person (acceptable)

recommendation.reasoning: Why pass or fail? What specific issues?

template.additional_notes: Any other observations about Famili V1 preservation or engine quality?
